newsitem.title: USA: Circus Circus files $300 mln shelf in debt.
newsitem.headline: Circus Circus files $300 mln shelf in debt.

text.p: Circus Circus Enterprises Inc said Monday it filed a shelf registration with the Securities and Exchange Commission to sell up to to $300 million in debt securities.

The Las Vegas-based company said it intends to use the proceeds from the sale of the debt for general corporate purposes, which may include acquisitions, capital expenditures and repurchases of shares of the company's common stock.
Circus Circus owns and operates 10 hotel-casino properties with about 16,000 rooms in the State of Nevada.
